# Chang Diving Center
> Dive school and scuba shop on Koh Chang, Thailand (Klong Prao Beach). SDI/TDI/PADI courses, day trips, wreck diving, snorkeling, and gear — since 2005. Languages: English (`/en/`), German (`/de/`), Thai (`/th/`).

Prefer language-prefixed URLs. Default / English canonical hub: `/en/`. Contact: +66 894-013-927. Site search (noindex utility): `/en/search/`, `/de/search/`, `/th/search/`. Sitemap: https://changdiving.com/sitemap.xml

- [Contact (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/contact/): Booking and location

## Popular courses
- [Open Water Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/open-water-diver/): Beginner certification (≈3 days)
- [OWD + Advanced package](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/open-advanced-package/): Open Water + Advanced combo
- [Advanced Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/advanced/): Next step after Open Water
- [Deep, Wreck & Nitrox](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/deep-wreck-nitrox/): Specialty package on HTMS Chang
- [Rescue Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/rescue-diver/): Rescue training
- [Divemaster](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/divemaster/): Professional pathway
